Chapter 605: Chapter 33: Cultivation Achievements (Please Subscribe)_2

Longshan Yuan’s parents were just ordinary people and had not experienced any adversity,

Since Lin Yuan’s rise, each day had been comfortable, with almost zero chance of igniting the divine fire.

“Without reaching the Supreme Being, one eventually has to face the limits of lifespan,” Lin Yuan realized within his heart.

The Supreme Immortal Kings of the Spirit Realm, the gods of this world, seemed eternally long-lived, but it was only eternity in their immortal and divine bodies.

Weak beings, in the face of eternal time, have their minds gradually twisted and decayed, their cognition, their understanding of all things, is influenced by time.

The same event might be viewed differently by a being who has lived ten thousand years compared to one who has lived only a hundred years.

...

The Supreme Immortal Kings and the gods just haven’t lived long enough. Live another hundred million or a billion years, and they may go insane, even contemplating suicide.

The spirit will cannot withstand the test of time.

Only the Supreme Beings, the ultimate existence on a certain evolutionary path, Twelfth-Rank Life, with eternal and indestructible spirit will, are truly eternal.

Of course, even Supreme Beings will die, but definitely not due to age.

“Having the Door to the Myriad Realms, and many means to protect my life, I could almost say I won’t die unless it is by my own actions, but unless I become a Supreme Being, there will still come a day when I die, and no one will be able to save me,”

Lin Yuan thought, the Supreme Beings of the Main World also have loved ones, parents, and siblings, but unless one becomes a Supreme Being, there will come a day to die of old age.

Those who fully understand the Rule of Time can use it to control the flow of time around their bodies, achieving an ‘alternative eternity.’ Essentially, it’s about slowing down the time influence on their spirit will.

A millennium in the external world may pass, while only a day goes by for the individual; the spirit will experiences just that one day.

…

“Now, my strength…” Lin Yuan closed his eyes, his consciousness descended into his inner world.

A vast inner world measuring one point nine nine five billion square miles, the Mysterious Gourd containing seven types of colored liquids, each type could amplify Lin Yuan’s physical body and inner world by three point three three times.

Having completely absorbed the first six types of liquid, the final amplification would reach one point nine nine eight billion square miles.

And an inner world of one point nine nine five billion square miles meant that Lin Yuan’s absorption of the sixth type, the blue liquid, was nearing perfection, and he was about to start touching the last purple liquid.

“Maybe reaching the Tenth Rank is necessary to fully absorb the purple liquid?” Lin Yuan speculated quietly.

The amplification of the inner world required consideration of both physical and soul strength; the strength here was fundamental strength.

Every time Lin Yuan traversed, he would wait until he had recovered to his peak before summoning the Mysterious Gourd, firstly because he wanted to ensure he had enough power to protect himself.

Secondly, if his strength was too low, even with the high-level ‘Blood Rebirth,’ his physical soul might not be able to bear such a vast inner world.

“Spatial Layers…” Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking deeper into the spatial layers of his inner world.

Lin Yuan had an early inkling of the size of his inner world, and he knew the amplification each colored liquid would bring, having deduced the final size of his inner world before this traversal began.

But the spatial layers… that was a pleasant surprise.

The Divine Lattice of this world, in terms of opening up spatial layers, absolutely exceeded Lin Yuan’s expectations.

In Lin Yuan’s expectations, if he could open up ten million layers of space during this traversal, reaching the Ninth Rank Myriad Heavy Realm, he would have perfectly achieved his goal.

But ten million layers of space?

Six hundred years ago, once Lin Yuan penetrated the essence of space from the Demigod Lattice, his inner world had already reached a hundred and twenty million layers.

Over the next six hundred years, Lin Yuan studied various true divine natures and prime divine forms with spatial properties, and in terms of opening spatial layers, he reached—

“Twenty-three billion three hundred and ten million layers…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze penetrated multiple spatial layers, and the thickness and substance of his inner world had reached an unimaginable extent.

In the Main World, when countless Ninth Rank strong beings treated the ten million Spatial Layers as the peak of the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan had already opened up 2.331 billion Spatial Layers?

In terms of the number of Spatial Layers, it was 233.1 times that of the normal ten million layers at Ninth Rank,

but in terms of actual power, was it not tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of times more?

“This traversal, the gains were truly immense.”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but marvel inside, 2.331 billion Spatial Layers—this was a number previously thought unreachable by all Ninth Rank lives since the birth of the Main World Prime Universe.

Lin Yuan dared not claim that the Spatial Layers he had opened were unmatched in the Main World, but being unmatched in history was undeniable.

This ‘ancient’ did not just refer to Human Civilization, the Starry Sky Races, including those Peak Clans and unique special beings, could not possess this number of Spatial Layers at Ninth Rank.

“I don’t know what my Inner World will look like when it transforms into an Inner Universe in the future,” Lin Yuan looked forward with anticipation.

The transformation of an Inner World into an Inner Universe represented the utmost sublimation, breaking all shackles and limitations.

At that time, the Inner Universe would not be confined to a size of ten million square miles, and the Spatial Layers would naturally evolve into something more profound and vast.

As for how much it would transcend, that depended on the original size and depth of the Inner World.

Hunyi, the strongest Ninth Rank life from the Tianyu Clan, had opened more than thirty million layers in his Inner World—was he just doing this for fun?

With the time it took to open thirty million layers, one could have likely stepped into the Tenth Rank by now, and the increase in combat power would definitely far surpass going from ten million to thirty million Spatial Layers.

Other clan’s Ninth Rank strong beings, if they had spare capacity, would always try to open as many Spatial Layers as possible at Ninth Rank. Ten million layers was merely their minimum threshold.

Why open so many Spatial Layers at Ninth Rank? It was to make the transformation of the Inner World into an Inner Universe a sublime breaking of all shackles.

“Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter…” Lin Yuan shifted his focus from the Inner World to scrutinize the perfected Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

Compared to the previous Seventh Rank Chapter and Eighth Rank Part, the Ninth Rank Chapter was crucial in adjusting the structure of the Inner World, making it more stable and powerful.

For Ninth Rank strong beings of the same Inner World size, same Spatial Layers, and similar foundations, those who follow the Ninth Rank Martial Tao would definitely have an advantage.

Moreover, according to the bloodline cultivation pathways of this world, Lin Yuan had specifically created a bloodline purification and cultivation method for the Martial Arts Evolution System.

While the Martial Arts Evolutionaries were comprehending the Great Dao rules, they could also spend time exploring the potential of their own bloodlines. As long as the bloodline’s limit was high enough, the pace of strength enhancement would certainly far exceed the speed of comprehending Great Dao rules.

Of course, this cultivation method was only suitable for those citizens with high-ranking, extremely rich bloodlines, and the upper limit was level seven.

Because the Main World valued human rights and could not gather faith, relying on this cultivation method would not allow one to independently open a Divine Kingdom, hence they could not step into the Eighth Level.

In Lin Yuan’s conception, those Martial Arts Evolutionaries with high-ranking bloodlines could fully explore their blood’s limit to rapidly advance through the Fifth, Sixth, and Seventh Rank, then re-comprehend the Great Dao rules with a high perspective.

“The bloodline evolutionary path… is ultimately not the Great Dao.” Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

The nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization, nor the Supreme Beings of other Peak Clans, none had reached the ultimate levels solely with their potent bloodlines.

The Star Alliance, composed entirely of special beings, whose top powerhouses sat, had noble bloodlines, but those who managed to step into the Twelfth Rank did so not on account of their bloodlines.

In some ways, bloodlines were actually a kind of shackle on the path to the peak.

“Having perfected the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and also added a branch to the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, overall enhanced the foundation and strength of the Martial Arts Evolutionaries…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, satisfied in his mind.

He then raised his right hand, his thoughts subtly moving; the speed of time on his skin began to twist, either slowing down or pausing, mismatching the main flow of time.

“The Rule of Time…”

Lin Yuan looked lively, having spent a significant amount of effort in comprehending the Rule of Time over the past six hundred years.
